instructions: This project is SYNTARO — a GitHub bot that turns labeled issues into PRs.
READ ../.opencode.md BEFORE writing any code — it documents the exact tech stack, test helpers, and architecture patterns for both SYNTARO and OpenSymphony.
NEVER fabricate libraries. This project uses Vitest (NOT Jest), Playwright (NOT Cypress), Biome (NOT ESLint for formatting), tsx (NOT ts-node).

Test helpers already exist: createTestHarness() in tests/e2e/harness/, ConsoleCapture/ActionLogger/NetworkCapture in tests/automation/core/, mocks in src/__tests__/mocks.ts, fixtures in src/__tests__/fixtures.ts.
ALL imports use .js extension (NodeNext module resolution).
NEVER use @jest/globals, jest.fn(), or jest.mock() — use vitest's vi.fn() and vi.mock().
Bot pipeline: Webhook (Express) → Queue (RabbitMQ) → Agent Dispatch → Fix → PR.

syntaro.description: SYNTARO. Submit GitHub issues and get automated fix PRs.
